description: Compose a multi-panel scientific figure layout. Takes panel pixel dimensions (and optional detected axis positions per panel) plus figure settings, returns panel positions/sizes in millimetres using the aligned-grid engine: axis lines aligned per column/row, plot areas matched so baked-in text sizes unify. No image data is needed or accepted.

axes.description: Detected axis line positions/insets in source pixels (optional)

name: compose_figure
